add-person.already-exists: That name already is already in use! Please choose another one.
add-person.max-attendees-met: The maximum number of attendees has been met. You can register if someone else unregisters or if the event owner increases the limit.

delete-person.dialog-text: Are you sure you want to delete

inactive-people.dialog-text: People that have not registered or unregistered for more than 5 weeks, are automatically moved to the list of inactive people. An inactive person is simply reactivated by registering or unregistering again.
inactive-people.matching-person-text: already exists, but has been inactive for a while. If this is you, you can press the switch to reactivate your profile.

scoreboard.activity-score-tooltip:
The person's attendance over the last 6 months. 1 point is granted for every attendance. The value of the point gradually decreases weekly until worth 0 in 6 months. So a point given today is worth 1 full point, while only worth 0.5 in 3 months from now.

Each week the people on the event are sorted by this score.
scoreboard.average-response-time-tooltip: The average response time from the moment registrations for this week's event opens. The registration opens at midnight after the day of this week's event
